user.title: Skolan
user.description:
Skolan is a homework app for kids (vocabulary, quizzes, reading aloud, rewards and pets). The app itself is in Swedish.

Pick an AI service if you want Skolan to read photos of vocabulary lists, weekly letters and textbooks (optional).

barn.title: Add a child
barn.description: Each child needs their own Home Assistant user. A child only sees their own homework.

foraldrar.title: Parents
foraldrar.description: Parents see all children, send quizzes and approve homework done outside the app.

notiser.title: Parents' phones
notiser.description: Pick a phone for notifications to {namn} (optional).

error.anvandare_finns: That user is already a child.

omstart.title: Restart to apply Skolan's new settings
omstart.description: You changed Skolan's settings. Restart Home Assistant to apply them.
